Name: Fippsie's Strolly Poly for CP (plus animal husbandry support)
Author: Fippsie
Description:
[center][size=5]
[b]This mod turns Strolly Poly from Core Keeper into barn animals![/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/ZnhBqJQy/strollypoly.png[/img][/center]
[center]
Mature Strolly Poly can drop Strolly Poly plates that you can sell.or gift to people (who might like this? careful everyone else dislikes it :))[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]You can download the optional file to add Animal Husbandry compatibility! 
With AMH they will "magically" turn into bug meat.

There are four color variants (yellow, blue, green, pink). All of them are enabled by default. 
You can disable any colors you don't like in inside the config that gets generated after you start the game with the mod once.

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI﻿[/url]﻿.
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿[/url]﻿.
3. (optional) Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url][/center]
[center]4. Download and unzip the main file (plus the optional file if you want AHM support) into \Stardew Valley\Mods\.
5. Run the game using SMAPI.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=2][i]You can safely remove this mod at any time by deleting it from your Mods folder.
Accidentally removed the mod and want your Strolly Poly back? Just reinstall it and everything will return to normal automatically.[/i][/size][/center]
